stem: During an end-of-shift check, a pharmacy receives its first DEA registration and will begin stocking controlled substances tomorrow. What inventory event is required?

choices.text: Take the first inventory at the end of the first month.
Wait two years because only biennial inventories are required.
Inventory only Schedule II stock on the start date.
Take an initial inventory of controlled substances on the date controlled-substance activity begins.
Use the wholesaler's invoice as the pharmacy's initial inventory.

explanation.core_reasoning: 'Take an initial inventory of controlled substances on the date controlled-substance activity begins.' is the governing result. By contrast, 'Take the first inventory at the end of the first month.' would require that federal law allowed a post-opening grace period. The decisive cue appears in 'During an end-of-shift check, a pharmacy receives its first DEA registration and will begin stocking controlled substances tomorrow. What inventory event is required?'.

choice_analysis.A: 'Take the first inventory at the end of the first month.' would apply only if federal law allowed a post-opening grace period; 'During an end-of-shift check, a pharmacy receives its first DEA registration and will begin stocking controlled substances tomorrow. What inventory event is required?' states otherwise.
choice_analysis.B: 'Wait two years because only biennial inventories are required.' would apply only if the initial-inventory trigger did not precede the biennial cycle; 'During an end-of-shift check, a pharmacy receives its first DEA registration and will begin stocking controlled substances tomorrow. What inventory event is required?' states otherwise.
choice_analysis.C: 'Inventory only Schedule II stock on the start date.' would apply only if the initial inventory excluded other controlled schedules; 'During an end-of-shift check, a pharmacy receives its first DEA registration and will begin stocking controlled substances tomorrow. What inventory event is required?' states otherwise.
choice_analysis.D: 'Take an initial inventory of controlled substances on the date controlled-substance activity begins.': supported by initial inventory.
choice_analysis.E: 'Use the wholesaler's invoice as the pharmacy's initial inventory.' would apply only if purchase records alone satisfied the registrant's inventory record; 'During an end-of-shift check, a pharmacy receives its first DEA registration and will begin stocking controlled substances tomorrow. What inventory event is required?' states otherwise.

related_facts: A newly registered handler must take an inventory of controlled substances on hand on the date first engaging in controlled-substance activity.
